prompts.text: Name a bird

prompts.text: Name an insect or creepy crawly

prompts.text: Name an animal that lives in the ocean

prompts.text: Name an animal native to Africa

prompts.text: Name an animal native to Australia

prompts.text: Name a farm animal

prompts.text: Name an animal people keep as a pet

prompts.text: Name an animal starting with S

prompts.text: Name an animal starting with B

prompts.text: Name an animal starting with P

prompts.text: Name an animal starting with M

prompts.text: Name an animal with 4 letters or fewer

prompts.text: Name a cat breed

prompts.text: Name a dinosaur or prehistoric reptile

prompts.text: Name a type of tree
